To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

thioredoxin, a redox-regulating protein, is expressed in pancreatic ductal carcinoma, that its expression level is higher in CDDP-resistant cells, and that the plasma level of TRX is higher in patients with this cancer.
the expression of TRX and/or GRX is associated with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
plasma levels of TRX, redox-regulation proteins, are significantly higher in patients pancreatic ductal carcinoma than in healthy controls.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the possible involvement of TRX and/or GRX in the pathogenesis of pancreatic cancer.
the possible role of TRX and/or GRX in the pathogenesis and/or drug-resistance of pancreatic ductal carcinomas.
the role of TRX and its family members in pancreatic cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
TRX expression is up-regulated in pancreatic cancer tissues and CDDP-resistant cells, and that TRX may be a useful marker of pancreatic cancer.
the expression of TRX and/or GRX in pancreatic tissues is closely related to the development of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
the redox-regulating protein TRX and GRx are expressed in pancreatic ductal carcinoma and may play an important role in the growth promotion of pancreatic cancer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
TRX is a useful marker for diagnosis of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and that GRX is a useful target for the therapy of pancreatic ductal carcinomas.
the redox system is involved in the malignant potential and chemoresistance of pancreatic cancer.
TRX and GR X might play an important role in the growth and chemoresistance of pancreatic cancer cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
TRX and GRTX may have important roles in pancreatic cancer progression.
pancreatic cancer is associated with higher levels of TRX and that TRX levels may increase in the presence of CDDP.
TRX and GRXR are overexpressed in pancreatic cancer and may be associated with drug resistance of cancer.
